title: AVP, Engineering, Sustainability Security & Risk, Corporate Real Estate
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
===============

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

**Why Join**
============

Imagine a role where you can make a tangible impact on the bank's operations and the environment. As a Corporate Real Estate professional at OCBC, you'll be responsible for ensuring our premises are safe, sustainable, and efficient. You'll be part of a team that's passionate about creating a better future for our customers, employees, and the community.

**How You Succeed**
===================

To excel in this role, you'll need to take a holistic approach to managing OCBC corporate offices - daily operations and maintenance of premise facilities, MAC and sustainability management to ensure a smooth, safe and conducive work environment.

**What You Do**
===============

The individual will be responsible for driving operational efficiency, implementing sustainable engineering solutions and ensuring compliance with environmental and energy regulations. The role balances day-to-day engineering oversight with long-term sustainability initiatives that align with corporate ESG goals and regulatory requirements.

Engineering Facilities Operations

* Oversee and monitor critical system (MEP, HVAC, electrical, water, waste and energy infrastructure) to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operations.
* Manage preventive and corrective maintenance programs; ensure regular maintenance contracts are in place, servicing is completed in a timely and effective manner.
* Liaise with vendors, contractors and consultants to ensure service quality and compliance with technical standards.
* Supervise all term contractors and ensure that they deliver the contractual level of service standard.
Recommends maintenance, mechanical, electrical, plumbing and facility design modification.  

Environmental Sustainability Management

* Lead initiatives on energy efficiency, water conservation and waste reduction. This will include formulating policies and innovative solutions to reduce energy consumption and carbon footprint.
* Track, analyse, collect data and report carbon footprint (scope 1-3 emission) for sustainability reporting, conduct quality check and integrity of the collected data.
* Identify and implement innovative technologies to enhance sustainability performance eg, smart office/building systems.
* Coordinate bank-wide communications, provide awareness, user education and engagement on all environmental sustainability matters. Assist to drive the ESG (Environmental, Social & Governance) initiative for the department.
Ensures Green Mark certification and timely re-certification for the CRE managed offices/branches and establishes improvements where necessary.  

Project Management

* Oversee and manage minor capex works, enhancement works, repairs & maintenance works including contract documentation.
Support feasibility study, due diligence, engineering solutioning, data analytics related works.  

Others

* Manage the external warehousing for furniture storage.

* Liaise and safeguard proper management of contractors and other relevant service providers.
* Liaise with building owners and internal staff to ensure smooth operation of facilities.
* Responds to stakeholder inquiries and complaints. Ensure timely and quality service delivery. Follows up to ensure satisfaction.
* Perform the role of alternate Business Continuity Coordinator for the department.
* To provide 24/7 support when necessary.
* Any other duties as and when assigned.

**Who You Are**
===============

* Degree or Diploma in Engineering/Real Estate/Property Management with at least 5 years of facilities management experience, with exposure in managing office critical facilities system and sustainability management, preferably in a financial institution.
* Experience in maintenance of M&E, plumbing, fire suppression & protection, BMS related systems.
* Self-motivated, driven and possess good analytical/problem solving skills.
* Able to understand technical drawings, specifications and requirements.
* Able to work independently, a strong team player and to handle fast-paced projects.
* Good interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills for collaboration with stakeholders across all levels.
* Independent and ability to multi-task and meet multiple deadlines.
* Strong in Microsoft office applications (i.e. Excel, Powerpoint, Word, AutoCad).

**What we offer:**
==================

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

description:
**Job Responsibilities :**  
Monitor site environmental conditions, including cleanliness, pest control, noise, dust and waste disposal.
  
  
Implement measures to prevent mosquito breeding, rodent infestation and other environmental health issues.

Maintain environmental records and reports, and coordinate with NEA, PUB and other relevant authorities during inspections.
  
  
Conduct environmental briefings and toolbox talks to raise awareness among site personnel and subcontractors.
  
  
**Requirements :**  
Degree or Diploma in Safety / Environmental / Occupational Safety & Health or equivalent
  
  
Registered Environmental Control Officer (ECO) with NEA Singapore.
  
  
Minimum 2–3 years of relevant environmental management experience in construction, civil engineering or industrial projects.
  
  
ECMO certification or registration as a WSH Officer is preferred.
  
  
Familiar with Singapore's environmental regulations, including EPHA, COPEH and NEA/PUB requirements.
  
  
Good reporting, inspection and coordination skills, with the ability to identify issues and implement practical solutions.

description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
===============

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

**Why Join**

  

As part of OCBC’s ambition to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future, you will play a senior role in shaping and delivering the Group’s sustainability agenda. Working closely with the Group Chief Sustainability Officer, senior management, businesses and subsidiaries, you will help translate this ambition into clear priorities, practical initiatives, stakeholder engagement strategies and measurable outcomes.

You will partner businesses and subsidiaries across markets to advance opportunities, manage risks, strengthen governance and disclosures, shape stakeholder engagement, and represent OCBC in the wider sustainability and financial sector ecosystem.

  

**How you succeed**

  

You combine strategic judgement with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to execution. You build strong partnerships across business, risk and support functions, and translate complex and emerging sustainability topics into clear direction, practical actions and credible narratives for internal and external stakeholders.

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Develop, review and support the implementation of the Group’s sustainability strategy, priorities and commitments, translating them into actionable plans, initiatives and measurable outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional initiatives, partnering business units, subsidiaries and support functions to identify, shape and deliver sustainability-related initiatives, including business solutions as well as internal process improvements and capabilities.
* Support the development, review, promotion and implementation of sustainability policies, frameworks, standards, practices and reporting in collaboration with business units and relevant control functions.
* Monitor sustainability, regulatory, risk, market, industry and competitive developments, translating insights into opportunities, risks and strategic implications for the Board and senior management.
* Represent OCBC at industry forums, conferences, roundtables and other engagements, and contribute to thought leadership on sustainable/transition finance and emerging sustainability topics.
* Oversee the development of appropriate positioning and messaging on key sustainability topics across markets.
* Build and manage relationships with regulators, government bodies, industry associations and ecosystem partners to support OCBC’s sustainability agenda, franchise and market positioning.

**What we are looking for:**

* Graduate degree from an accredited university or equivalent.
* At least 15 years of relevant experience, with demonstrated success in banking, financial services, sustainable finance, sustainability or a related field.
* Strong understanding and prior experience of financial institutions and how sustainability considerations apply across the sector would be an advantage.
* In-depth knowledge of sustainability frameworks, taxonomies, regulatory and industry developments in Singapore and the region.
* A forward-looking and practical problem solver who can identify key issues, simplify complexity and translate insights into actionable recommendations and solutions.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders across businesses, functions, regions and cultures, and plan, prioritise and deliver multiple workstreams concurrently with strong execution discipline and attention to detail.
* Excellent stakeholder management, strategic thinking and communication skills, with experience representing an organisation externally and briefing senior leaders.
* Collaborative team player who builds trust across teams and with stakeholders, and demonstrates OCBC’s values of Lasting Value, Integrity, Forward-looking, Respect and Responsibility in how work is delivered.

**What we offer:**
==================

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

description:
Angle Recruitment has partnered with a well established liner and bulk shipping group to find an Environmental Data Specialist who can bring order to how it collects, measures and reports its impact.
  
  
Like every shipowner, the business has to report its carbon emissions, waste and water use. It burns fuel at sea, uses electricity ashore, sends crew and staff around the world, and buys goods and services from hundreds of suppliers. The rules for reporting all this are clear. The data behind it is not. Some figures come from systems, some from spreadsheets, and some from a vessel emailing numbers to the office. Each office does it a little differently, so the totals are hard to trust.
  
  
Your job is to fix that, and make sure it stays fixed.
  
  
You'll sit in Finance, reporting to the Finance Controller, because the priority is numbers that stand up to an auditor. You'll work closely with a small sustainability team of four, two on the fleet side and two in corporate, who know the business and the targets. Most of your focus will be on the liner business, with some support for the bulk side.
  
  
**In practice, you will:**  
Set the rules.
  
  
Turn group data policy into a practical way of working, with clear owners, controls and the evidence an auditor will ask for.
  
  
Find the gaps.
  
  
Map where every piece of carbon, waste and water data comes from, and spot the duplication, risks and manual workarounds.
  
  
Check the numbers.
  
  
Test data from across the business, spot what doesn't add up, and explain why.
  
  
Deliver the tools.
  
  
Build the case for practical tools and automation, then implement them within the systems that exist today.
  
  
Crack Scope 3.
  
  
Build a sensible approach to supplier, travel and crewing data, including business travel emissions and offsetting.
  
  
Make it stick.
  
  
Write clear guides and train the people who supply the data, so the process runs long after the two years are up.
  
  
You'll bring hands on experience managing Scope 1 and 2 inventories under the GHG Protocol, and a good eye for whether data is clean. You'll have designed data processes and controls that held up to review, ideally with some exposure to Scope 3 and external assurance. Shipping knowledge is useful but not essential. The client is open to someone slightly earlier in their career, as long as the carbon accounting and data quality skills are genuinely there.
  
  
In return, you'll get a clear brief, real influence across the business, and a competitive package. It's two years to build something that lasts.
  
  
Global Maritime Talent Experts
  
  
Angle Recruitment is a global company that specialises in maritime recruitment and executive search. With our extensive industry expertise and commitment to excellence, we combine traditional values with state-of-the-art technology to deliver exceptional recruitment solutions. Our goal is to establish ourselves as the trusted partner for maritime professionals and organisations seeking top-tier talent. Headquartered in Singapore, one of the world's largest shipping and commodity trading hubs, Angle Recruitment is strategically positioned to serve the global maritime community.

**Short Description**
---------------------

**Job Summary**

This role sits within the Sustainable Finance team in the Wealth and Retail Bank (WRB), and supports the wider team across the initiatives being rolled out across the private bank, wealth management and SME bank. In particular, the role will focus on building up the bank’s profile as a leader in carbon markets among private banking and SME clients. The candidate will focus on the development of the HNW and SME carbon markets proposition, materials development and business development. He/she will support in the education of frontline, COO and risk colleagues, to support the onboarding of SME carbon project developers and the accompanying solutions to meet their needs.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Business**

**SME:**  
• Support the proposition build for SME carbon developers, including developing banking solutions to support their growth.
  
• Work closely with Singapore business and rest of SME markets to enable onboarding of carbon developers or broader carbon ecosystem.
  
• Develop client materials and build up SME frontline champions.
  
• Support development and implementation of SC WIN campaigns in key markets. SC WIN is our women entrepreneur proposition.

**PvB:**  
• Support development of carbon markets and broader SF client discussion materials for private banking client engagement.
  
• Work with business to identify list of clients for engagement. This will include clients in high carbon sectors and agriculture.

**WM:**  
• Support development of carbon markets and broader sustainable investing content.
  
• Work with product teams and asset managers on developing carbon markets product ideas.
  
• Supporting the distribution of one-bank carbon solutions.
  
• Support ongoing annual sustainable investment product reviews and due diligence.
  
• Support monthly development of Sustainable Investments Universe.

**Processes**  
• Work with markets to ensure that processes are in place to mitigate greenwashing risks during product launches.

**People and Talent**  
• Support in driving internal awareness of carbon markets.
  
• Work with product teams on educating frontline on carbon themed products during product launches.
  
• Support in equipping front line colleagues with an understanding of carbon markets and sustainable finance.

**Risk Management**  
• Support climate risk embedding across key WRB businesses.
  
• Support embedding of reputational and sustainability risks across WRB businesses.

**Governance**  
• Support in ensuring that sustainable finance proposition is in line with our governance standards to prevent greenwashing

**Regulatory and Business Conduct**  
• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  
• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  
• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**  
**• Market Heads across segments – consumer, private and SME bank**  
**• Front Office teams – PvB and SME**  
**• Legal and Compliance**  
**• Group wealth management product teams**  
**• Marketing**

**Other Responsibilities**  
**• Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CPBB Sustainable Finance**

**Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------

* **Education: Bachelor's or advanced degree preferred in Wealth Management, Sustainable Development, Development Finance**

**• Training: 5 years experience in Sustainable Finance, Wealth Management**  
**• Languages: Business Communication**

----------------------------------------

* **Sustainable Finance**

**• Project Management**  
**• Communications**  
**• Wealth Management**  
**• Carbon Markets**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.**
